top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic Cape Town Cycle Tour's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before March.
When someone attacks on coastal rolling, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.

Road-specific control matters at Cape Town Cycle Tour. Practice on coastal rolling: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 67 miles.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on coastal rolling can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Cape Town Cycle Tour. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
67 miles on coastal rolling burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
58ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Cape Town Cycle Tour, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Cape Town Cycle Tour. Train it until it feels boring.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,937ft of climbing on coastal rolling does to your power file on race day.
Varied gradients on coastal rolling demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

THE factor is the Cape Doctor south-easterly wind. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks, including rain protection and wet-road braking, and practice stable positioning in crosswinds before Cape Town Cycle Tour.
